def: a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together)

occurrences.text: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
